schema_rag.question: What percentage of unique customers placed more than one order?
schema_rag.raw: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id);

schema_rag.question: What percentage of delivered orders arrived late in each year?
schema_rag.raw: SELECT strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_pct FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

schema_rag.question: What is the average delivery time in days for each review score?
schema_rag.raw: SELECT r.review_score, AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_days FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.review_score ORDER BY r.review_score;

schema_rag.question: Which product category (English name) had the highest revenue in 2018, and what was that revenue?
schema_rag.raw: SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC, category LIMIT 1;

schema_rag.question: Which product category (English name) has the lowest average review score among categories with at least 100 reviews?
schema_rag.raw: SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_reviews r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY avg_score ASC, category LIMIT 1;

schema_rag.question: Show the cumulative item revenue by month over the whole dataset.
schema_rag.raw: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY month) SELECT month, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative FROM m ORDER BY month;
